📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: September 4, 2026)

On Friday, September 4, 2026 (Reiwa 8), the 3rd Regular Session of the Hanno City Council opened.

The session runs from September 4 through September 29, and council members are scheduled to deliberate on a total of 30 agenda items and approvals, including proposed ordinances, supplementary budget proposals, and road-related motions.
